feedback.title: Report a problem with {{name}}
feedback.description: This prepares an issue for the repository the skill came from. Nothing is sent from here: you read it on {{site}}, then file it yourself.
feedback.descriptionNoSite: This prepares a report for the repository the skill came from. Its host is not GitHub or GitLab, so copy the report and file it where that repository takes issues.
feedback.public: Anyone who can see that repository's issues can read this. Leave out keys, tokens and private details.
feedback.happenedHint: What you asked for, what the skill did, and what you expected.
feedback.happenedPlaceholder: It edited files before showing the summary the skill says to show first.
feedback.proposalHint: The wording that would have prevented it.
feedback.previewHint: Exactly this text goes into the issue, the first line as its title. Nothing from this computer is added.
feedback.opening: The report is long, so it was copied. Paste it into the issue that opened.
